title: I love AI game development, making my dream game
author: sevenoutdb
selftext: I'm making this awesome 2D space combat game, I know this is a fertile and well worn category but I think you guys will love it when you get your hands on it. Check out these battles. What you're seeing is the starting ship with upgraded rail guns, maxed out rocket swarm attack and veteran ace gunships with maxed out weapon pods. First a battle against the space corpos and then a battle against the raiders. There is a LOT more to this game, but I really want to nail these moments. Any thoughts? Questions?

There’s more! I’ll post some other stuff soon.

I just had a blast with that fight and I had to show someone, anyone. This is fair feedback if this looks too simple to be worth a few bucks though. 

ChatGPT did an analysis of some 30 minutes of video capture and gave me a ton of art, design and marketing notes. Said I need to start showing people and getting real feedback, like what you’ve responded with here.

Thanks
